dedupe_keys.name: rijkswaterstaat water data waterinfo and waterwebservices

description: Rijkswaterstaat produced these water measurements, gathered for daily management and legal duties on the national waters, and offers them in three ways: the Waterinfo map with current, forecast and historical values, a form that e-mails the requested historical data as a CSV file, and the WaterWebservices built on the AQUO information model, with a discussion platform on GitHub. Coverage is the Dutch national waters. The data are free, and the WaterWebservices content is under CC0 for download and reuse. Caveats: the public map only goes 28 days back and 2 days ahead, and requests may be limited under heavy use. Simulation uses: water level and discharge series and forecasts for flood defence loading, emergency response and digital twins of the river system. Related records: LIWO flood information (data-netherlands-liwo-flood-information) and the primary flood defences (data-netherlands-primary-flood-defences-nbpw).
